notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.2.3
notes.content:
Beta Patch v.0.2.3
I painted a lot of backgrounds, including one for a brand new battle stage, the Funky Swamp. With this patch, I am happy and proud to announce, there are no more generated images in the game. All illustrations and backgrounds are painted traditionally in ink and watercolor on watercolor paper. I am extremely happy with my decision of replacing the generated art with real art and greatly look forward to expanding the game with new hand painted battle stages and card illustrations in the future.

Content

Brand new battle stage: Funky Swamp.


Art Style

Brand new title screen.
Improved Hammer art.
Replaced Enchanted Forest battle stage background.
Replaced Spirit Realm battle stage background.
Replaced Brimming Meadow battle stage background.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an edge case regarding Sokras’ usage of Tide Generator and Secret Stash.


Polish

Adjusted positioning of various title screen elements.
In game, player models are brighter and subtly tinted orange when hovered over. This is for better overall look and readability.
Further tweaked gem colors.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.1.1
notes.content:
As of now there are no more generated images present in the build and I am proud to say that all backgrounds and illustrations are hand painted in traditional ink and watercolor style.

Content

Brand new battle stage: Funky Swamp.


Art Style

Reworked title screen.
Replaced battle stage backgrounds.


Polish

Adjusted positioning of various title screen elements.
In game, player models are brighter and subtly tinted orange when hovered over. This is for better overall look and readability.
Further tweaked gem colors.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.1.0
notes.content:
I decided to replace all generated image illustrations with my own watercolor illustrations. Title screen and backgrounds are next.

Art Style

Replaced illustrations for all cards by hand painted watercolor and ink paintings.
New Hammer art.
New Sokras art.
New card frames.
New gem images.
New Sources.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.2.2
notes.content:
I spent the last two weeks painting to replace the art for Hammer and Sokras. Now all generated images have been removed from the game with the exception of the backgrounds. These will be replaced next. Apart from painting I fixed a few minor bugs and added some polish. I also decided that Storm Catcher does not work as I imagined and it’s up for a rework or replacement.

Art Style

New Hammer art.
New Sokras art.


Bug Fixes

Amber Engine description text now correctly states that the Source is discarded and not scrapped.
After the game ends, no more connection status messages are displayed.
Fixed typo in Coral Reef’s description.


Balance

Storm Catcher provided Sokras with a lot power but it was not very interesting to play against. I therefore decided to disable it for now and will replace it with another gadget or rework it fundamentally.


Polish

Added illustration credit.
Adjusted card frame and gem images colors and positioning.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.2.1
notes.content:
The improvements to the network code would be quite major by themselves, even bigger is the art style shift commencing in this patch: I decided to remove all generated images from the game. Those that still are in the client can be considered placeholders. During the coming transition period that will precede a period of refinement, the game will look somewhat disjointed. I am convinced, however, that it looks more charming and unique even in this current state of transformation.

Art Style

Replaced Dagger Illustrations.
Replaced Pistol Illustrations.
Replaced Amber Illustrations.
Replaced Amethyst Illustrations.
Replaced Emerald Illustrations.
Replaced Ruby Illustrations.
Replaced Sapphire Illustrations.
Replaced Aquamarine Illustrations.
Replaced Source Illustration.
Replaced gem images.
Replaced card frames.


Balance

While I really like the new Amber Engine, often you found yourself adding Sources each turn to replace the one’s you scrapped. This was somewhat tedious and could easily be rectified by making it so Amber Engine merely discards the Source upon activation instead of scrapping it.
Modified Sokras’ scaling so they only very rarely bring a second mod to class.


Achievements

A new achievement, “Oldest of the Old”, rewards those who reach Student Rank 100.


Polish

When starting a game against Sokras or local multiplayer, you will automatically leave the matchmaking queue. I found that playing while in queue can feel somewhat stressful as you might get pulled out of the game at any moment. Disallowing this leads to a better user experience: You either look for an online opponent and arrange a game if no one is in the queue, or you play against Sokras at your own pace without interruptions.
During online play, the connection to your opponent is monitored. Should it run into trouble, you are notified, prompted to wait and a log entry is created. When the connection is reestablished, you will get notified and invited to continue play.
When an error occurs during matchmaking you get feedback and are prompted to try again.
Major improvements to the matchmaking process further increase reliability. Remaining issues due to delayed response of Steam API calls should happen rarely and be resolved by trying again.
Rating is not shown anymore during multiplayer games, only on the victory screen. This keeps the game visually clean and decreases pressure when matched against a stronger opponent.
The portrait frame appeared slightly blurry on bigger screens and is now of higher resolution.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.2.0
notes.content:
There is a saying in game design: “follow the fun“. During testing I realized that it is great fun just to play relaxed games against Sokras, no pressure, just the challenge to beat your patient teacher. And this was the case even while their deck was pretty basic. So I decided to follow this fun and make the Skola experience a more interesting, build it out so it has even more variety and Replayability and come up with a system that is expandable in the future as well.

So from now on, after reaching Student Rank 10, Sokras will bring a random gadget from their private collection to class that changes things up a bit. I also improved Sokras’ power management greatly and made it dynamically react to the cards in their deck. In the future I will keep improving Sokras’ play patterns and adding new and interesting modifications to their collection.

And you know what else turned out to be great fun? Achievements! So a bunch of new ones have been added this patch, partly tied to the new gadget system, and I will implement many more for you to unlock.

Another big change is the rework of Amber Engine. The old Amber Engine worked, in so far as it provided a lot of power. So much so that power was almost no longer a consideration at all (especially in combination with Mechanical Bird). I came up with a new version that helps generate power but can also make use of Sources as material for enabling strong attacks.

Features

After reaching Student Rank 10 (Practitioner), Sokras will bring a special modification to class that can shift the dynamic of the game. The modification is chosen from his personal collection of gadgets. At the highest ranks (Maestro and Elder), there’s a chance they take a second one. Defeating Sokras while they have brought one of their gadgets to class, will unlock an achievement, and defeating them with two, unlocks another special achievement.
New achievements related to Amber Engine, Sandstorm, Falcon Strike, Sweat Collector, Substation and Into the Storm.


Balance

Amber Engine has been reworked. While the old version was cool, it basically solved all power issues by itself, making the game less interesting. Amber is a color that should play with Sources and revolve around resource management to efficiently make use of its powerful modifications. The new version gives a power bonus when playing a Source and allows you to scrap a Source from your hand for a high offensive boost. This fits Amber’s theme perfectly and fulfills the fantasy of a mighty Amber Engine fueled by Sources.


Polish

Improved Sokras’ Source management. They react more dynamically and sensibly to the game state and take into account the power usage of their deck.


Quality of Life

When you gain temporary attack value, a log entry is created. When a card used to say “increase your attack value by 1 until and of turn”, it now says “gain 1 attack bonus”. This is a very intuitive way of phrasing it much shorter.


Bug Fixes

Sokras correctly determines their defense setup count when considering to play Undercurrent. They don’t play it when it would kill them or deal more than 1 damage to themselves.
Sokras no longer tries to use Junkyard without a valid target in some situations.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.7
notes.content:
I spent a lot of time this patch on the matchmaking algorithm trying to make it more resilient to errors. There is still a lot left to do but things are being learned and progress is being made. Apart from that I introduced some quality of life features I planned to put in for a while, namely being able to check what gems you and your opponent currently have socketed and to learn about the Gembearer decks from the main menu.

A big balance change is that the highest Student Title is now only achieved at Student Rank 50. I plan on teaching Sokras a few new tricks, making the single player experience more interesting and this is the first step in doing so. Much more is soon to come.

Balance

The most prestigious Student Titles are only achieved at a much higher Student Rank. This also affects Sokras’ scaling, expanding the single player progression. This system will be developed upon soon.


Quality of Life

When hovering over a character portrait, a list of the socketed gems is displayed next to the tooltip Gembearer card. Some gems are hard to distinguish from one another especially on Steam Deck or smaller displays. This should remedy that issue and improve accessibility.
In the title screen, you can now click the question mark symbol next to your selected character to take a look at the Gembearer cards.
The player’s ratings are displayed under their names in online matches.


Bug Fixes

Joining an online match while in an offline game works again.
Playing Sources alternately no longer causes potential desyncs in online multiplayer.
Playing Lightning Tonic alternately no longer causes potential desyncs in online multiplayer.
The description for the Steam achievement tied to Intuition is now accurate.
Student Rank is displayed correctly in the main menu options.
Sokras no longer duplicates Mnemosyne when skipping card retrieval.


Polish

Further improved the matchmaking process.
The fidelity of modification images has been increased substantially.
To avoid confusing situations, you can no longer hide the Draft Row while your opponent is drafting.
Student Titles are displayed in color in the leaderboard to make them stand out more and make the entries visually more appealing.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.0.5
notes.content:
Demo Patch v.1.0.5
Even though the Student Rank scaling provided an interesting challenge, losing Student Rank can be frustrating, especially when first climbing to Elder. Therefore I made it so you no longer lose Student Rank on a loss. Furthermore, Sokras stops scaling after reaching Elder. Sokras is meant to be a sparring partner that is challenging yet possible to beat, and playing them should allow for experimentation without harsh punishment. Apart from that I discovered that it is fun and relaxing to just keep climbing and be rewarded with a steadily rising Student Rank.

Balance

You no longer lose Student Rank when losing against Sokras and they stop scaling after reach Elder. This allows you to continue climbing as long as you like on a challenging but beatable difficulty. To have Sokras go easier again, you can always reset the Student Rank in the main menu options.


Polish

Updated Hammer illustrations to match the full version.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.6
notes.content:
The main focus was on matchmaking and multiplayer stability this patch. As the achievements I introduced a couple of patches ago turned out to be great fun to unlock according to everyone I talked to, I added more of them and many more are still to come. I also introduced a new icon for general achievements so the colored icons can be used for gem specific achievements only.

Features

New achievements have been added to the game.


Bug Fixes

Matchmaking could run into issues when queuing at the exactly same time because players where joining each other’s lobbies. This should now be resolved.
Matchmaking stopped looking for a match after maximum rating tolerance has been reached. This has been resolved and matches should now form more smoothly.
Improved synchronization of game ending to avoid desyncs.
Improved fail safe mechanism in case of a player disconnecting during the start of a match.
Fixed Battery’s target synchronization in online multiplayer matches.
The low gem card count warning is only logged once per turn and not each time the user interface is updated.


Polish

General non gem specific achievements now show a neutral-colored achievement icon as to reserve blue icons for Sapphire achievements.
Made the in game options panel more visually appealing.
Players with 0 online games played don’t show up on the multiplayer ladder.
Improved Coral Reef multiplayer handling and made the feedback more responsive. Coral Reef is being highlighted when the passive is triggered and the proper log entry is created. The readied modification will also be highlighted.
Tweaked the matchmaking algorithm with regards to how the suitable opponent range is expanded.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.5
notes.content:
When queueing for a match you would sometimes seemingly find an opponent and then get stuck when they don’t confirm your handshake. This should not occur anymore, and I built a fail safe in case it does. Overall, the matchmaking works more reliably now, even with multiple people in the queue. As the online experience is a top priority, I will keep an eye on this and keep improving the code until it is as stable and fun to use as it can be. I also, hopefully, fixed the Coral Reef autotargeting if you only have a single modification and other minor bugs.

Bug Fixes

The matchmaking process has been improved to make online multiplayer more robust.
Coral Reef now works as intended in all situations.
The Risky Crossing achievement now properly unlocks only when you achieve it, not your opponent.
Sokras no longer plays Undercurrent when it would kill themselves.


Polish

Coral Reef highlights when the passive is triggered for better feedback.
Clash’s miss effect triggers after a slight delay for better feedback as is the case with Coursing’s.
In “Pass and Play” the draft row appears ever so slightly later after pressing a key to start your turn, so the announcement won’t briefly overlap the draft panel.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.4
notes.content:
Even after the buff to Tsunami, Aquamarine has been the weakest gem type overall with some cards being very strong and borderline problematic in certain specific situations. To address this I reverted Favorable Current to a version close to the paper one, only slightly increasing its attack bonus. To compensate I made the power gain portion of the basic Aquamarine attack and defense cards unconditional. 

I also reverted the starting deck size back to 12 cards. Not only did this present a notable discrepancy to the paper version, it also did more harm than good all things considered. If infinite loop decks remain problematic it will be rectified in a different manner.

Apart from game balance I got to spend a lot of time on improving the ways player and ladder information is displayed and I added a bunch of new achievements to hunt for or just to be happy about when getting them unintentionally. These include combinations such as readying Airship using Resupply, Mechanical Bird or Tide Generator or just efficient deck construction resulting into high pay-off via Tsunami, Onslaught or Despair.

Hammer received a new set of illustrations as her cards were still not in line with the look of her character. Now even her Gembearer and hair style matche the character model pretty much exactly.

Balance

The starting deck size is back to 12 cards.
Favorable Current will draw a card again and cost 1 power to use. The attack bonus has been increased from 2 to 3.
Breeze generates 3 power instead of 2, making it a more desirable pick.
Flow and Be Water always generate 1 power and only the life gain is tied to gem card skill played or in discard pile. This makes these core Aquamarine cards efficient and reliable power providers to fuel Favorable Current or inexpensive card effects in other gem types.


Features

Added a number of new steam achievements, and many more are yet to come.
Added graphic options. For now, you can change resolution and toggle fullscreen.


Quality of Life

The gem wins in the statistics screen are displayed as win rates rather than raw wins.
I merged the display of gem games and gem win rates into one bigger and more instructive pie chart that is also consistent with how Gembearer statistics are presented.
Changed the default graphic mode to fullscreen window for more desired overall behavior.


Polish

The main menu options panel has been restructured. It’s now split into three sections and the control overview as well as the credits have been moved to the link section under the main menu.
The control overview and credits panel have been rearranged to make them consistent to their new placement.
Slightly repositioned the “Main Menu” button in the win screen and renamed it to say “continue”.
Modified leaderboard display so it can accommodate large entry numbers.
Intuition now draws the cards simultaneously for both sides in online multiplayer.
The result screen at the end of the match fades in more quickly and very slightly later.
Replaced the Hammer illustrations for better quality and to better match the character.


Bug Fixes

Secret Stash should now close correctly when only retrieving some of the cards all of the time.
Fixed the error handling for Spark.
Intuition no longer allows you to discard an additional card by clicking a card before all three cards have been drawn.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.3
notes.content:
While not strictly necessary, statistics and a match history add greatly to the enjoyment of a competitive game. They are a visible expression of your play style and allow insights into your performance, to learn about your strengths and weaknesses, and to gain deeper insights into the functioning of the game as a whole. My implementation tracks quite a few metrics and I am happy that I managed to display a great deal of information on each individual online match with the option to add more in the future.

Regarding balance, I increased the starting time bank to five minutes. While games of Gemwielders can be quick and easy, a strategy game should allow for the careful planning of your chosen strategic path for each game. I want playing Gemwielders to be an experience that is at the same time challenging and comforting, the timer should reflect that. This system will likely be tweaked further still.

I also addressed infinite loops in this patch. While I like that they are possible in Gemwielders, they should be something that occurs when the stars align and the player has the experience and game knowledge to seize the opportunity. However, certain infinites seem to be realizable too consistently for players who know how to aim for it from the get go. Especially the adjusted Favorable Current proved problematic as it provided card draw as well as attack bonus increase for no power cost, presenting a win condition by itself when paired with card draw and card scrapping. I am therefore trying a new, more straightforward variation of the card. Additionally I have increased the number of cards in a deck to test how this effects the meta game. This change will make infinites slower to accomplish, giving the opponent more time to realize their own plans.

Features

You can click your profile name to show your recent online match history and overall statistics of your online games. Match results are saved locally as a JSON file, the Gembearer play and win rates as well as the gem play and win rates are recorded as Steam player stats.
Since I started collecting and displaying information (stored and accessed solely via the Steam infrastructure), I added a privacy policy explaining why and in what way this data is being used.


Balance

Increased starting time bank to five minutes.
Added a basic attack and defense card to each starting deck.
Favorable Current no longer draws a card if you played a gem card skill, instead it increases your attack bonus by an additional 2.


Bug Fixes

Pearl Diver only shows returnable gem card skills on your discard pile.
Added a fail safe mechanism to ensure that when a desync occurs in a turn a player wins, the game ends properly. This could occur if, for example, the use of Tide Generator does not register correctly on the other side.
Resolved issues regarding the syncing of Pistol, Tide Generator and City of Wind in online games.


Polish

Sokras now realizes that he can go for drafting a card if their opponent does not have enough free gem sockets to draft that card themselves. This prevents games from getting stuck on draft rows where Sokras (falsely) thinks he is cut off from multiple cards.
When drafting, Sokras is better at recognizing contestable two and three cost gem cards.
As the cumulative wins against Sokras are already expressed via the Student Rank, the win count will no longer be displayed in the Student Rank leaderboard. The student title, however, is now displayed (allowing for the addition of special titles at a later point).
When a match is found, your selected character will cheer.
Pressing “A” on the title screen will play your character’s attack animation.
By clicking on a card in the draft row outside of the draft phase you can inspect the card.
Displaying all gem card skills played, even without Tsunami in your deck, cluttered the screen too much for marginal benefits. Therefore the changes have been reverted to the approach from v.0.1.1.
Removing the win text from the win screen makes it cleaner and more enjoyable to look at.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.0.4
notes.content:
As the full version develops aspects of the demo started to look dated. That’s why I decided to transfer over some of the visual updates already, even though more is still to come.

Polish

Changed card frames for Hammer and Pistol.
New Hammer illustrations (not final).
Tweaked modification images.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.2
notes.content:
As of now you can truly “pick your weapon” – character select has been added to the game. You can now chose your character from the title screen and get to know them a little bit before you launch a match. As there are no mirror matches in Gemwielders, the second player will have priority in case of a conflict. Another big change this patch is the way Sokras scales and works. To make playing against them a relaxing and positive experience while waiting for a match or to simply pass some time, I made it so Sokras does not scale beyond Student Rank 10. Additionally, you won’t lose Student Rank anymore upon defeat, meaning you can keep climbing as long as you want. This means playing more is always rewarding and feels meaningful.

Features

You can now select a character from the main menu or chose to play random. This will determine the Gembearer you get to play for matches in online multiplayer games as well as against Sokras. If you are first to draft in an online game and your opponent choses to play your selected character, they get priority and you will be assigned a random Gembearer.
Sokras will tell you a about each character and the history of New Linden when browsing through the characters.


Balance

Sokras scales more slowly, stops scaling after Student Rank 10 and you don’t lose Student Rank upon losing anymore. This makes playing against Sokras challenging and rewarding but prevents the frustration of being stuck on a given Student Rank.
The timer reacts dynamically to turn count: The increment increases by five seconds every ten turns, and the second player gets a bonus of thirty seconds to make their mulligan decision. 


Bug Fixes

The description text of Be Water is now correct.
The description text of Coral Reef is now correct.
Drain handles invalid target selection more gracefully.
Fixed a potential problem with the submitting of ladder ratings.
The leaderboard displays entries with double digit win and loss counts correctly.
When ending the first turn without drafting any card in online multiplayer, the other player will not see an out of place discard animation anymore.


Quality of Life

The hand display now handles very high hand sizes efficiently.
A glimmering sound effect is played, once an online opponent is found.
When getting matched with an online opponent while playing in single player, a notification message is displayed.
When the gem card deck gets low on cards (under 10) a counter appears on the “show draft row” button. When it gets to 3 and lower, a log entry is created and a notification sound played.
Additional failsafe syncing in online multiplayer. Each desync will be corrected and documented in the game log so the root cause can be determined. A notification sound will be played.
The status effect represents each five attack bonus as one red sword, similar to how power is displayed. This is to better handle high attack bonuses that can come up in certain infinite combinations.


Polish

When winning or losing online or against Sokras, you will now be presented with a “Victory” or “Defeat” announcement and a matching sound effect.
In online games it will now say “Your Turn” and “Opponent’s Turn”. The communication of the game flow has been optimized for more clarity overall.
The result of the mulligan decision is announced in multiplayer games.
The Aquamarine gem image is now more easily distinguishable from Sapphire.
A very subtle chime sound effect is played, when starting to look for an opponent.
When an online opponent is found via the “Play Online” function, the button will be uninteractable and the match will start after a short delay.
Added sound effects to Sokras using Mnemosyne.
Gem card skills played will always be tracked by the status effect display once you socket an Aquamarine.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.1
notes.content:
This patch focused on the multiplayer experience, improving the net code and displaying more information on the leaderboards. Additionally, Sokras learned how to play Aquamarine properly and has some cool new tricks up their sleeves. Another change you should not overlook is to Substation. The ability of adding a Source to your discard pile was almost never useful, and I wanted to test if adding it to your hand instead would be strong and fun to play and experiment with. Apart from these, a new quality of life feature, the status bar, let's you see how much attack bonus you accumulated, if you played any gem card skills (and how many in case you run Tsunami), and how much life you lost (in case you run Despair). I also added a requested feature: you can now return attacks to your hand in the attack preparation phase and only commit to strike when you are happy with your setup.

Features

Wins and losses for online multiplayer matches are tracked and displayed in the leaderboard.
Wins for games against Sokras are tracked and displayed in the leaderboard.
You can watch your opponent taking the mulligan in online games and a log entry is created for both players.
Restructured matchmaking sequence and improved game starting logic for online multiplayer to make it more robust in higher latency situations.
Improved Sokras’ Aquamarine play, especially Ebb and Flow and Coral Reef usage.


Balance

When adding a Source using Substation, it’s added to your hand instead of your discard pile. Not only does this provide additional power, the gained Source can serve as discard fodder for Intuition or City of Wind. This change should ensure that both of Substation’s effects find regular use, depending on the situation.
The timer now works in a way that is much more intuitive: You have a three minute time bank that starts counting down on the beginning of each turn and an increment of ten seconds is added each turn. This will probably be adjusted in the future, potentially increasing the increment for lower rated lobbies and high turn counts.


Quality of Life

Attack Bonus is displayed by a small icon over your health bar. The status effect display will also show life lost this turn and skills played as soon as you have cards in your deck that care for it.
You can now click on an attack card in your current attack preparation to take it back to your hand. Note that your opponent might have seen the card already.
When pressing “A” after having already added an attack card, you will strike without adding all your remaining attacks. This is especially handy when playing Dagger on Steam Deck but also prevents unexpected behavior in general.


Bug Fixes

Using Tide Generator displays correctly for the opponent in online multiplayer.
Sokras uses Pearl Diver correctly even if no gem card skill is on their discard pile.
Improved Sokras’ handling of Secret Stash.
Using City of Wind in online multiplayer no longer causes a desync.
Artillery fires even if you use it when another card effect is still resolving.
Cleaned up Artillery’s effect handling to deal with edge cases more elegantly.
You can no longer launch an attack via pressing “A” while selecting a target for a card effect such as Junkyard or Pearl Diver.
You can no longer use the “A” key during your opponent’s turn in online multiplayer.
When cards are played alternately this should always log correctly.


Polish

Player models flash red upon taking damage.
When the timer goes down to 10 seconds it turns red and beeps every time it counts down.
Hammer received new illustrations that better match the look of the character model.
Added a sound effect when gaining an attack bonus from Artillery of Favorable Current.
Added a small delay to Coursing’s miss effect for a more satisfying result.
Made the close button on the leaderboards slightly smaller.
The draft tooltip does not show on your opponent turn in online multiplayer games.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.1.0
notes.content:
Like a wave of fresh air Aquamarine has arrived. A brand new gem type that will make sure each game truly feels unique and different. More gem types will be added following the launch. Another big addition is the introduction of skill based matchmaking. Players will be matched with a player of equal skill and the search range dynamically expands. Apart from that I have fixed a number of bugs, polished the gem selection and optimized the matchmaking under the hood.

Features

Aquamarine, a complete new gem type, has been added to the game.
Players are matched with other players of comparable rating. The search expands gradually if no player of similar rating is found initially.
The Student Rank leaderboard will only update if you improve your rank. This way you can keep trying to push your peak without having to fear dropping in the ladder. (Keep in mind that you can play against Sokras while waiting in the online matchmaking queue.)


Quality of Life

When exiting from a running game, you can now do so via the “concede” button. It will announce the concession and take you to the end game screen where you can look at the decks and rating change (depending on the game mode).


Polish

Optimizations of the matchmaking process for quick and reliable performance.
When socketing gems, the tooltip now immediately disappears when not hovering the gem anymore. This way it doesn’t interfere with gem selection anymore which could cause miss clicks.


Bug Fixes

In online multiplayer, at the end of a turn, if the decks, hands or discard piles are out of sync, they will be resynced and a log entry will be created for debugging. A sound effect is played so beta testers will take note and can report the bug.
Rating changes should now adjust and display correctly.
The effect display announcement no longer gets stuck on some ability usage in online multiplayer.
Tweaked displaying of error messages and general handling in varying game modes when trying to play a skill without sufficient power or invalid target.
Should the game end because of depletion of the gem card deck, the Gembearer name will be logged correctly.
Extort now uses the game seed to determine the discarded card, avoiding desyncs in online multiplayer.
Airship and Electrify don’t play the Source going to discard pile animation in online multiplayer for the inactive player.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.0.3
notes.content:
A quick hotfix of a few major technical issues to make testing the new online multiplayer mode an enjoyable experience.

Bug Fixes

Ladder rating changes are displayed and updated correctly and consistently.
You can no longer activate your opponent’s modifications or Gembearer during their turn in online multiplayer.
The timer no longer is in the way of activating the Gembearer ability.
Using the Pistol ability displays correctly for both players in online multiplayer.

notes.title: Beta Patch v.0.0.2
notes.content:
Closed Beta has launched, and I will be starting to look for additional testers soon. Online multiplayer is in, including a rating system and in game leaderboards not only for Player Rating but also for Student Rank. For now I use the classic Elo rating system (familiar from chess) that is a good fit for Gemwielders as well. So far only very few players have access to the game and, at times, no opponent will be available. While waiting for an opponent in the online queue, you can climb the Student Ranks against Sokras and compete to your fellow Gemwielders in the Student Rank ladder.

Features

The player name is displayed on the title screen and under the player portrait in online multiplayer games.
The player rating is displayed in brackets next to the player name on the title screen.
The player rating and rating change is displayed on the win screen.
The player ratings are recorded in a leaderboard so you can check your rank in comparison to others. 
After reaching Student Rank 3, the player’s Student Ranks are recorded in a leaderboard as well.
You can check the leaderboards by clicking on the medal icon next to your name on the title screen.
Added a game timer using a time bank system. Each player has a 5 minute time bank that starts counting down after a certain time into a turn (increasing with turn count). When your timer runs out, you lose the game.
You can play against Sokras or in Pass and Play while in online multiplayer queue. This is indicated by a small icon in the bottom left corner. As soon as an opponent is found, the game will start. Note that you won’t lose Student Rank when getting matched out of a game against Sokras.


Polish

Should the game initialization fail in multiplayer matchmaking, you are returned to the main menu. This is so you can never get stuck on the loading screen.
When Thicket's miss Effet is triggered and it stays in the defense setup it will be moved to the center position.


Bug Fixes

Cursed Cave no longer causes a desync in online multiplayer when the deck was empty on use.
Belladonna no longer causes a desync in online multiplayer when the opponent did not select a valid target.
Improved the handling of complex card effects to prevent issues with multiple triggering of skills in online multiplayer.
Both players arrive at the draft phase simultaneously in online multiplayer to prevent syncing issues.
Resolved an issue with regards to shuffling of the gem card deck. It now produces actually random results.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.0.3
notes.content:
When looking at a list of cards, be it a deck, discard pile or the deck list presented at the end of the game, the spacing between cards varied between resolutions. This should be resolved now and the lists should look nice and clean on very high resolutions as well as on lower resolutions or on Steam Deck. 

Apart from that: no notes. This is because the demo is currently in a very stable state and extremely low on bugs. I will, of course, fix any bugs that get reported. Also I am spending a lot of time on the full version and making good progress.

Polish

Made the list display consistent among varying resolutions.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Sokras proved to be too hard on his students and therefore received some adjustments. He will be as challenging as he always was on high Elder ranks, however. To further improve the new player experience the tutorial has been made less overwhelming. Other than that, the demo has been polished up, victory and defeat animations added as well as new portrait frames with bigger more shiny gems.

Balance

The first Student Ranks have become much easier and Sokras’ deck scales more slowly. Sokras has only 30 life on Student Rank 1 and his life is reduced to 40 on Student Rank 2. Only after Student Rank 3 will his special attacks and defense get stronger. Sokras does, however, continue scaling beyond Elder. Higher Elder ranks become achievable for experienced players now and provide a long term challenge.


Features

Characters express their emotions at the end of the game via victory and defeat animations.


Polish

New portrait frames with a clean look that fits the rest of the UI better. Bigger gem sockets improve readability on smaller screens and on Steam Deck.
When doing the tutorial, your hand will not be shown on the very first time you see the draft screen. This is not to overwhelm new players.
Further improved the positioning of the defense setup.
Animation flow has been improved in scenarios such as attacking into Engulf or High Ground.
Furnace scraps the card first and only then deals damage for smoother effect handling and sound.
Improve card movement across varying resolutions.


Bug Fixes

Student Rank is displayed correctly in the options panel while playing against Sokras.
Sokras recognizes correctly if there is no Fungus or Sabotage target in all situations and plays it alternately if there is not.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.0.1
notes.content:
After the successful launch of the demo I am continuing to make the demo experience better. I added a control overview to make it easy to check what hotkeys are in the game. Currently this is not customizable but that will be a feature in the full version. The timing of the new attack animations needed tweaking and was improved upon in this patch. Apart from that more polishing has been added in various aspects of the game, bugs have been fixed and some issues with high resolution monitors have been resolved.

Features

A control overview has been added to the options menu.
A tip informs you that you can press “L” to toggle the Game Log on and off.


Polish

Attacking into High Ground or Engulf no longer throws off attack animation timing.
When pressing the “reset” button in the main menu options panel, you will be prompted to confirm or cancel the resetting of your Student Rank.
Pressing “A” in the Draft Phase to finish drafting triggers a click sound.
Nightmare plays a skill use sound effect, and so does Belladonna when you use it on yourself.
When in “Pass and Play”, clicking at the player model while confirming that you are ready to start your turn no longer triggers an error message.
Made it easier to return a card to your hand after dragging it over the play area.
Tweaked the initial size of some menu buttons for greater consistency.
Tweaked the positioning of the Defense Setup.


Bug Fixes

Sokras no longer offs himself with Nightmare when he is on 1 life.
Sokras never tries to use a modification after the game is over.
Nightmare and Belladonna apply their effects in the correct order. (Nightmare hits the active player first, Belladonna deals damage before power is gained)
Improved list spacing on high resolution monitors.
Finishing drafting by pressing “A” no longer greys out the “End Turn” button afterwards.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.1.0.0
notes.content:
This patch is identical with the version that will be available to everyone in one week. It’s feature complete, stable and bugs should be far and few between. New animations have been added, most notably for attacking, a brand new mouse cursor has been introduced to complete the visual identity of the game, bugs have been fixed and Steam Deck compatibility improved. That being said, I will continue to add features and address bugs in the demo while working on the full release as well as implementing the lessons learned from the feedback of the community. Let the journey begin!

Features

When attacking, the characters attack with their Gembearers.
Playing skills and using modifications are emphasized by an animation.
New mouse cursor that better fits the clean icon style of the game.


Bug Fixes

Using the right mouse button on a skill works properly even when hitting the top of the hovered card.
Proofed against potential issues with using the “A” key.
Hovering a card while Sokras is using Sabotage or Battery alternately no longer causes it to disappear in certain scenarios.


Polish

Improved touch control compatibility.
Pressing “A” in the Draft Phase ends it (This is especially useful when playing on Steam Deck).
Pressing “A” in the Combat Phase when not holding any attacks ends the turn (Improves Steam Deck Controls).
Expanded Credits
When the game runs out due to no gem cards being left in the gem card deck, a log entry is created.
When Drain is being played alternately by Sokras, the proper log entry is created.
Battery is making a sound when being played on a Gembearer.

notes.title: Demo Launch Event
notes.content:
The Demo features “pass and play” mode as well as a computer controlled character you can learn the game from and play against. Each time you beat Sokras, he will award you with a new Student Rank and make the next game more challenging for you. Will you become his most promising student or even obtain the rank of Elder?

Features

Play against your friends using Pass and Play on a shared PC or via Steam Remote.
Learn the game and get to know your teacher Sokras.
Climb the Student Ranks to unlock achievements.


To experience this event together with other Gemwielders around the world join the live stream on twitch or come to the discord to share your decks, strategies and successes.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
You can comfortably play Gemwielders on your Steam Deck by using the trackpad for mouse movement and setting up a simple custom control scheme.

Suggested Control Scheme


L2: Left Mouse Button
R2: Right Mouse Button
A: A Key (adding all defenses or attacking with all cards)
X: S Key (for inspecting a hovered card)
B: Space Bar (to move through the tutorial dialogue)


With your right thumb for mouse controls and these key bindings nothing stops you from wielding gems on your portable device.

Touch support is currently being worked on and might cause issues in the current state.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.3.4
notes.content:
As the release of the Gemwielders Demo nears, I am concentrating on fixing bugs and adding more polish to make the demo as shiny as I can before launch. I fixed a number of bugs regarding Student Rank as well as a couple of issues concerning Sokras. When you check or uncheck “Skip Tutorial” you hear a sound effect for better feedback and user experience.

Bug Fixes

Student Rank updates correctly at the end of a game against Sokras.
Improved Student Rank and Steam interaction and fixed minor display issues.
All settings are loaded correctly on game start.
Sokras doesn’t duplicate Intuition under any circumstances.
Sokras no longer tries to use Artillery when he doesn’t hold any attack cards.


Polish

Added a sound effect when checking or unchecking “Skip Tutorial”.
Changed the font of the Student Rank in the in game options panel.
The win screen is a tad less dark, so you can take in more of the background atmosphere.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.3.3
notes.content:
We have achievements now! I added a basic achievement system that rewards you for climbing the Student Ranks. You also get an achievement for completing a “pass and play” game. The Student Rank is stored on Steam’s servers, so you can’t easily manipulate it locally. This will reset your Student Rank. You can, however, chose to skip the tutorial now by checking a box in the options menu. The characters received a new animation and Sokras uses his modifications more logically. I also updated the art on Vanguard and Sandstorm as the old illustrations didn’t quite feel right.

Features

Added Steam integration to implement stats and achievements.
Student Rank is stored safely on the Steam servers.
Added basic achievements corresponding to the obtainable Student Titles.
Added an achievement for completing a game of “pass and play”.
You can now check "Skip Tutorial" in the options menu.
When characters take damage, a small animation is played.
Sokras doesn’t use Mechanical Bird on Cursed Cave after he returned the card or on Deeproot if he didn’t hit any defenses.
Sokras never uses Resupply on Mechanical Bird.
Sokras doesn’t use Mechanical Bird or Resupply on Amber Engine when he has enough power.
Sokras doesn’t use Cursed Cave after just having used Armory.
Sokras uses Mnemosyne only after playing out his other skills.


Bug Fixes

If Onslaught is bounced by Shadowstep the appropriate log entry is created.
Shadowstep should work properly in all instances.
Tapping Stone with Fungus on it will only trigger Dark Pact once.


Polish

The winner is marked by a medal in the win screen.
Adjusted the size and placing of the tutorial dialogue text.
Added a right mouse button icon to Resupply to indicate that you can play it alternately just to draw the card.
Changed the hotkey for inspecting a card to “S” to prevent activation every time when tabbing out.
While redrawing your hand in your draw phase, the cards don’t react to hovering. This prevents possible issues with hand display.
Fungus and Battery are added to the deck list in the win screen if they were on any of the player’s modifications or their Gembearer.
Deeproot notes the number of added cards in the log.
New Sandstorm artwork.
New Vanguard artwork.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.3.2
notes.content:
The placeholder models have been replaced with new animated models! For now they feature an idle animation only, but more are to follow soon. To make this happen I am cooperating with Enhydra Games. They support me with their amazing talent and experience in the gaming industry. Apart from this major feature update, I tweaked Sokras’ Source management, fixed a number of bugs and added a good amount of polish.

Features

Added brand new animated character models.
Added credits in the options panel.


Balance

Sokras drafts a second Source during his early turns.


Bug Fixes

Sokras stops playing cards and or modifications after a certain number of loops (to prevent soft locks that could theoretically occur).
Secret Stash properly logs and triggers Fungus when retrieving cards.
The decks shown at the win screen correctly include the card that was played as a finisher.


Polish

Life bars are shorter to match the new models.
Life bars represent negative life values (for impact).
Checked all typography for consistency and tweaked where necessary.
Emphasized the difference between the card hover highlight and the play state highlight and tweaked the play position to make it easier to return a card to hand without playing it.
Added a short delay before the win screen appears for dramatic effect.
Log entries are hidden earlier when reaching the edge of the panel for a cleaner look.
The active player arrow adjusts properly to varying resolutions.
When Sokras plays Falcon Strike without activating any of its effects, the skill fizzle sound is played.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.2.2
notes.content:
Short patch notes this time as a lot of work has been done on internal processes and to prepare for an upcoming major update. A few bugs have been fixed and Sokras’ behavior has been improved.

Bug Fixes

When a card is drawn after returning a card with Intuition or placing a card on top with Armory, the deck is no longer refilled but remains at 0. The deck should only refill when a card is needed.
Sokras does not try to use Secret Stash anymore when low on life and there aren’t any cards stashed.
Sokras, in all instances, only tries to use Furnace when he has a valid target.


Polish

Sokras stops playing his turn after the game has ended.
After the game ended, no more log entries are created.
Added the version number to the in game options panel.
Removed quotation marks from Sokras’ quotes for a cleaner look.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.2.1
notes.content:
The Win Screen received a major overhaul and now displays both decks at a glance. Nightmare has been changed to a very clean solution that fits well thematically and gameplaywise. Apart from that a lot of bugs have been fixed, most importantly the ones where Sokras would get stuck when using certain cards or combinations of modifications and a bug that allowed cards to be scrapped from the draft row without fulfilling the gem requirement. And last but not least, the tutorial’s readability improved significantly.

Features

The win screen shows the portraits of both players with the gems they socketed and the winner highlighted as well as a full list of both decks for a complete overview of the game and better shareability.


Balance

Nightmare now reads: „All players lose 1 life. Draw 1 card.“ This version of Nightmare fits the theme of Amethyst very well. It synergizes with Despair and Dark Pact and could create interesting choices in conjunction with cards such as Cursed Cave or Armory. It also will pair well with Aquamarine, indirectly buffing the gem.


Bug Fixes

Sokras can no longer get stuck in a loop when playing Recycle.
Sokras correctly drafts Fungus when the opponent has a usable modification (and doesn’t have Dark Pact).
Fortified Position correctly checks for modifications.
Hide correctly triggers even if attacker is at full life.
When creating a desktop shortcut via steam, the icon is displayed correctly.
When the full deck list of a player is accessed the correct cards are returned. This caused a number of issues that should now have been resolved.
Sokras should no longer get stuck using Mechanical Bird in certain cases.
Fixed faulty condition checks for applying Extorts, Leprous Slaps and Pillages effects.
You can no longer scrap a card from the draft row without fulfilling the gem requirement.
The sound settings in game are always in sync with the sound settings in the main
Thicket no longer creates a log entry when discarded.


Polish

Sabotage now logs which card is set to used.
Connections logs the card that is drafted.
Sokras drafts Resupply, Battery, Fungus and Sabotage more often.
When Sokras uses Cursed Cave to return a card, this is logged after the modification usage has been logged.
A log entry displaying the matchup is created at the start of the game.
When dragging on a modification, the play arrow is always on top of other modifications. (Most noticeable when using Mechanical Bird.)
Hitting or missing is displayed as floating text.
Adrenaline plays the card handling sound only once when adding the cards to hand.
Added a condition check for Despair so it isn’t triggered when no life was lost that turn.
Improved visibility for key elements of the tutorial. The portrait dialogue got an underlay so it stands out more and the “press space to continue“ text flashes every few seconds to remind players of what they need to do to proceed.
The corners of Sources are rounded.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.2.0
notes.content:
This patch marks a huge milestone. Sokras has learned all the cards which makes the demo feature complete. What’s left to do is bug fixing, adding some quality of life features and polish, polish, polish. Speaking of quality of life: You can now inspect cards to read them in peace either through clicking on them in a list or, where this is not applicable, via hovering them and using the “left alt” key. I also implemented the requested feature to pause the game after each turn in “Pass and Play” to allow for a clean player swap, keeping hidden information hidden. Apart from that the patch brings a lot of improvements to the log, more tips for the title screen and quite a bit of visual polish. Oh, and before I forget, we have a shiny new discord server now which everyone is invited to join!

Features

Sokras learned to use Secret Stash.
Sokras learned to use Mechanical Bird.
Sokras learned to use Connections.
Sokras knows all the cards.
At the bottom of the title screen you are shown a new tip every ten seconds.
A button invites to join the discord server on the title screen.


Quality of Life

Added an option to inspect cards. You can do so by clicking on a card in a list or in the defense setup (unless it’s hidden information), or by hovering the card and pressing “left alt” for cards that are in your hand or in the draft row.
In “Pass and Play“, the game waits for the next player to confirm they’re ready.


Bug Fixes

Dealing the final blow with a usable ability closes the effect display window in all cases.
Added additional protection to the “Play All” hotkey so it can no longer be triggered multiple times.
Sabotage works properly for regular use and when Sokras uses it.
Clicking the opponent’s Gembearer never yields an error message.


Polish

The speed of the card draw animation when refilling your hand is consistently set even if it is the first animation playing.
Tweaked the colors of the card highlights and made it reactive to hovering in the hand, draft row, on a usable Gembearer and on usable modifications.
Added a short delay after taking the mulligan for better flow in “Pass and Play“.
Improved Sokras’ usage of Resupply.
When the conditions for certain cards aren’t met, they are not highlighted. This affects Fortified Position, Superior Weaponry, Leprous Slap, Sneak Around, Pillage and Hide.
A new clean options panel matches the style of the game.
The log panel matches the style of the options panel.
Readying a modification with Resupply or Mechanical Bird creates log entries.
Shadowstep creates log entries for the cards it returned to hand.
Battery and Fungus log entries are color coded.
Vanguard creates a log entry for the revealed card.
Adrenaline creates log entries for the revealed cards.
Returning a card with Cursed Cave creates a log entry.
The log stops adding entries after the game has ended.
Taking and declining the mulligan creates a log entries.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.1.7
notes.content:
The tutorial is mostly complete: In your first match you play as the Hammer and get introduced to the game rules and basic concepts. The second game as the Pistol teaches you how to use your Gembearer and introduces you to a small number of advanced ideas. The new hotkey “L” quickly brings up and closes the log and it logs more events. Sokras knows how to use almost every card and uses it competently, making them yet again harder to best.

FEATURES
• Refined and extended the tutorial.
• Sokras learned to use Cursed Cave.
• Sokras learned to use Mnemosyne.
• Sokras learned to use Fungus.
• Sokras learned to use Battery.
• Sokras learned to use Resupply.
• Sokras learned to use Sabotage.

QUALITY OF LIFE
• Pressing “L” toggles the log on and off.
• Clicking a revealed card in the defense setup now displays it briefly.

BUG FIXES
• Cursed Cave triggers Fungus on use in all instances.
• Curse Cave works as intended with Fungus and Dark Pact.
• Student Rank is adjusted in the in game options panel when looking around after the game is over.
• When using Mnemosyne with only 1 card in the discard pile, no error message because of the empty discard pile is displayed after retrieving that card.
• Trying to use a card with Battery on it without having enough power displays the correct error message.

POLISH
• Leprous Slap logs power paid first and only then the discarded card and bonus damage dealt.
• Fungus and Battery will add an entry to the log when their effect is triggered.
• Triggering City of Wind, Junkyard and Dark Pact creates a log entry.
• Shuffling the discard pile to refill the deck creates a log entry.
• Adding a Source to your discard pile via Airship, Electrify and Substation creates a log entry.
• Retrieving cards with Mnemosyne creates log entries.
• Discarding a card with Intuition creates a log entry.

notes.title: Demo Patch v.0.1.6
notes.content:
Ladies and Gentlemen we have a combat log! The log tracks all important game events and should add greatly to overall readability. It will also make bug hunting more efficient. Another big quality of life improvement is the Scrap Pile, allowing you to keep track easily of cards that are out of the game. Bugs have been fixed and Sokras learned a few new tricks and is starting to present a real challenge even at medium ranks.

FEATURES
• Added a color coded log that displays turn count, gem socketing, card drafting and scrapping from Draft Row, skills played, modifications used, life gain and loss, power gain and loss, attack success, card draws, card discards, card scraps, attack effects, defense effects, hit effects, miss effects, Gembearer effects and combat information.
• Sokras learned how to use Junkyard.
• Sokras learned how to use Furnace.
• Sokras learned how to use Armory.
• Sokras learned how to use City of Wind.

QUALITY OF LIFE
• You can now check what cards have been scrapped.
• Pressing “escape” in game opens the options panel.
• The sorting order of sorted lists is now affinity, card type and only lastly alphabetical. Sources are always found at the end of the list.

BUG FIXES
• Fungus displays correct error messages.
• Fungus works correctly on Amber Engine.
• Nightmare never damages or drains power from a player who isn’t the target of the skill.
• Artillery correctly sets to used when Sokras uses it.
• Junkyard cannot scrap Sources.
• It’s no longer possible to use Falcon Strike multiple times.

POLISH
• When gaining life at 50 life, no sound effect is played or visual indicator shown.
• Improved the win screen. Additionally, you can close it now to read the log and look around.
• Wen Sokras draws multiple cards the sounds are played in short succession instead of at once.
